scope: Primary-executed configuration, registration, compatibility and diagnostic checks. Independent reviewer opinions are recorded separately after the isolated reviews finish.

registration.scope: Fresh scratch registration and payload integrity for authored domain leads, not agent activation or delivered work.

limits: Scratch projects only; no user project changed.
Warnings compare configured global names, not live host availability.
Preserved copies still exist and can remain discoverable; no cleanup or host activation claim.

export.limits: Export bytes and entrypoint behavior, not client plugin activation

diagnostic_permissions.permission_fixture: Actual POSIX mode 000 on an unselected scratch copy, restored only after verification for scratch access
diagnostic_permissions.selected_target_preflight: Unreadable SKILL.md still fails the existing name-collision preflight before writes. This is intentional safety, not a diagnostic-only failure.
diagnostic_permissions.limits: Successful actual permission checks use an active Codex target with no selected jobs; Claude has four selected jobs. Per-receipt metadata denial within a selected target is additionally covered by unit fixtures. Scratch behavior only.

before_default_fix.method: Read-only Codex CLI app-server skills/list; no model turn
before_default_fix.limits: CLI discovery only, not desktop selector or actual agent invocation.

fresh_normal_selection.method: Read-only Codex CLI app-server skills/list; no model turn
fresh_normal_selection.limits: CLI discovery only, not desktop selector or actual agent invocation.

preserved_after_migration.method: Read-only Codex CLI app-server skills/list; no model turn
preserved_after_migration.limits: CLI discovery only, not desktop selector or actual agent invocation.

archive_compatibility.scope: One reviewed automatically installable upstream entry per archive-mode catalog source; full archive parsing plus original and adapted hash verification.
archive_compatibility.selection: Prefer entries with extra file mappings, then adaptation, then lexicographic ID.
limits: One selected payload per eligible source, not every skill payload.
Does not check file-fetch or manual-only source delivery.
No downloaded code, dependency, installer, hook or skill runtime was executed.
No skills were installed; downloaded archive and payload bytes remained in process memory.
Existing archive/parser budgets were unchanged; orchestration added wall-clock deadlines.
Network failures and incomplete work remain failures or unavailable; no automatic retries.

applicability_to_current_source.note: Registry fingerprint differs because role aliases changed elsewhere. These remote checks were not rerun.

additional_checks: 16 discovery tests including nine requested role nouns
16 export tests including runtime and Finder residue filtering

limits: Review and checks concern this configuration layer; no claim of perfect agents, universal quality or guaranteed task selection.
Codex app-server skills/list observes CLI discovery only; it does not establish desktop or Claude invocation. Preserved unselected copies remain discoverable until deliberately reconciled.
No existing user project changed, dependency installed, account connected, production action or new service/MCP activated.
Historical guided domain trials keep their original fingerprints. Five rubric-heading changes were not followed by a new outcome experiment.
Native Windows, physical devices, every browser, live services, bitmap craft outcomes and human visual acceptance remain outside these checks.
